- $x(i, j, k)$: Artist $i$ exhibits in Theme $j$ Hall $k$.

- Clause 5: `x(1, 1, 0) ∨ ¬x(0, 5, 1)` $\rightarrow$ **(Cond 5)**: Jack in Abstract/Main OR Emily NOT in Modern/Secondary.
- Clause 6: `¬x(0, 5, 1) ∨ x(1, 3, 1)` $\rightarrow$ **(Cond 6)**: Emily NOT in Modern/Secondary OR Jack in Surreal/Secondary.
- Clause 7: `¬x(1, 1, 0) ∨ x(0, 5, 1)` $\rightarrow$ **(Cond 7)**: Jack NOT in Abstract/Main OR Emily in Modern/Secondary.
- Clause 8: `¬x(0, 5, 0) ∨ x(1, 1, 0)` $\rightarrow$ **(Cond 8)**: Emily NOT in Modern/Main OR Jack in Abstract/Main.
